description: This file defines a Go collector for Prometheus metrics, specifically collecting runtime memory statistics and CPU usage metrics related to garbage collection.

classes.name: goCollector
classes.description: A Prometheus collector for Go runtime metrics, including memory stats and GC CPU fraction.

methods.name: NewGoCollector
methods.description: Creates an obsolete version of the Go collector, initializing memory metrics and setting parameters.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Provides descriptions of all metrics collected by the goCollector.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects current runtime memory and CPU metrics and sends them to the provided channel.

methods.name: msCollect
methods.description: Helper method to collect and send memory statistics metrics.
